messages:
Maya (ML): quick question — bringing up llm-chat-70b q8. did a 2-region perf sweep (us-west1 / ap-northeast1) and results are noisy. dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/bench/llm-chat-70b-q8 :eyes:

Sam: saw that. high-level: flashv3 wins p50 for short seqs in us-west, but apac shows worse p99 for flashv3 vs triton. probably small-batch effect + kernel warmups.

Jia: pasted the quick numbers from the bench job:
```
model: llm-chat-70b-q8
seq_len: 512 / 2048
batch: 1 / 4
--- us-west1 (H100) ---
flashv3: p50 18ms p95 90ms p99 150ms tps 42
triton:  p50 22ms p95 85ms p99 110ms tps 45
--- ap-northeast1 (L40) ---
flashv3: p50 24ms p95 120ms p99 210ms tps 30
triton:  p50 28ms p95 100ms p99 130ms tps 38
```
Jia: attached full CSV to the job if someone wants to dig (benchmark-bot uploaded).

Luis: interesting — flashv3 lower median but higher tail in APAC. likely due to kernel selection overheads + fp16->q8 path differences on L40. vendor Triton kernels seem to be more stable at high seq len for that hw. also check KV cache eviction patterns, they can spike p99.

Taylor: for rollout decision we should codify a small switch playbook. proposal:
- criteria to pick Triton over FlashV3:
  - observed p99 improvement >= 25ms across a 24h sweep OR
  - throughput increase >= 10% at target seq distribution
  - AND no material quality regression (eval delta < 0.5% on top-1 accuracy/eval set)
- hysteresis: require window of 10m + min 1000 requests before flipback
- region override: allow per-region kernel pinning if cross-region delta > 15%

Maya (ML): I like that. also add cost_per_token threshold since Triton on L40 might be cheaper even if p50 slightly worse.

Sam: +1. Also, implement canary traffic routing: 5% for 1h, 25% for 6h, then 100% if no regressions. Add automatic rollback on p99 degradation > 30ms or quality regression.

Jia: wrote a quick selector rule we can load into runtime: 
```yaml
selector:
  model: llm-chat-70b-q8
  rules:
    - metric: p99_ms
      compare: delta
      threshold: 25
      prefer: triton
    - metric: throughput
      compare: pct
      threshold: 10
      prefer: triton
    - fallback: flashv3
  hysteresis_minutes: 10
  min_samples: 1000
```

benchmark-bot: scheduled job `bench/llm-chat-70b-q8/24h-regional-sweep` created. results to /s3/bench/llm-chat-70b-q8/1915. ETA 26h.

Luis: one more caveat: quantization sometimes exposes subtle model quality regressions in rare prompts. add prompt-set based evals (1000 prompts) and tie alerts to that.

Taylor: actionable ops tasks:
- @ops-bot run regional 24h sweep asap (Maya/Jia to review config) :calendar:
- add route config to canary pipeline (Sam)
- add prompt-set eval hook to rollout checks (Luis)

Maya (ML): I'll own the evals and do a small audit on the L40 q8 inference path. will post follow-up with p99 strat if we see stable improvements. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: acknowledged. queue id: Q-5567. will start sweep in 10m.

Sam: FYI — if we end up pinning kernels per-region, we should update the cost dashboard (token unit economics will change). cc: finance later.

Jia: tagging results here when available. thanks all.
